programs.title: Lord Of The Flies
programs.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programs.title: Zombieland
programs.desc: A mysterious plague turns most people into bloodthirsty zombies.Only a few manage to avoid infection.This lucky group includes a clumsy and clumsy Columbus student.The boy is afraid of almost everything.The prospect of living in a world overrun by beasts terrifies him.Meanwhile, his friend, the brave Tallahassee, is excited about the whole situation.He is a tough guy who intends to single-handedly kill every monster that stands in his way.The men must fight the monsters together.They can count on the help of the sisters - Wichita and Little Rock.The girls try to alleviate the tense atmosphere between the men.For them, enduring each other's company is as difficult as getting rid of zombies.

programs.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programs.desc: Ten years have passed since Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson), Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg), Wichita (Emma Stone) and Little Rock (Abigail Breslin) decided to face a world full of the living dead together.It seemed that they knew everything about zombies and knew how to deal with them.Over time, however, bloodthirsty creatures managed to evolve and spread throughout the country.Four heroes must face a new threat.The problems are mounting, and there are typical family conflicts between them.On their way, they also meet other survivors.Sequel to "Zombieland" from 2009.This is another collaboration between Jesse Eisenberg and Woody Harrelson - they met, among others,on the set of two parts of "Illusion".A mixture of chocolate and coffee was used to create realistic-looking blood - the main actors agreed that it tasted like chemicals and they would not like to play zombie characters who had this fake blood in their mouths and on their teeth.

programs.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programs.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programs.title: Undercurrent: The Disappearance of Kim Wall
programs.desc: The story of the murder of Swedish reporter Kim Wall, which took place in August 2017.As the investigation revealed, famous inventor Peter Madsen lured a woman into an underwater boat that he built himself.During a cruise along the coast of Copenhagen, Wall was to interview the designer.When she did not return, a search began which revealed the shocking truth.The case of the journalist's death also draws attention to the issue of women's safety in the modern world.Wall received specialized training to prepare her for various work situations.Despite this, she died in a theoretically safe place.

programs.title: The List
programs.desc: Matt is cheating on his fiancée Abby with a celebrity from the "exceptions to monogamy" list.The hurt woman decides to pay him back in kind.

programs.title: Anaconda
programs.desc: Doug (Jack Black) and Griff (Paul Rudd) have been friends since childhood.They have always dreamed of making a remake of their favorite film, the horror film "Anaconda".When both buddies experience a midlife crisis, they decide not to wait any longer and set off together deep into the Amazon to start filming.The situation becomes more complicated when... a real giant anaconda appears on the film set, spreading chaos and destruction around.Despite the deadly threat, the friends decide to take advantage of the predator's presence.

programs.title: L'amica geniale
programs.desc:
Elena Greco is an elderly woman who tries to solve the mystery of the disappearance of her friend - Raffaella Ceruullo, who was called Lila.The women met in their early youth - in 1950, when they attended primary school.The old woman recalls her early years.The action of the series takes place in dangerous and charming Naples and spans 60 years.The story of their relationship is unconventional, because although Lila was Elena's best friend and confidant, she was also her enemy.The series is an adaptation of the novel by Elena Ferrante
Elena returns to Naples.However, he keeps his experiences on the island a secret because he is ashamed to talk about them even to Lili.She, in turn, confides in her friend everything that happened to her this summer.Although her parents support her relationship with Marcello Solara, Lila chooses Stefano Carraccio and even gets engaged to him.A young man spoils his beloved.He gives her gifts and speaks highly of her shoe designs.He also wants to become a family partner in business matters and distribute the shoe models prepared by Lila.Elena realizes that her friend is gaining more and more sympathy from the neighborhood boys, and because she doesn't want to stand out from her too much, she also finds a new partner.The choice falls on Antonio, a car mechanic whom she cannot even love.Elena wants to find out if Lila really has feelings for Stefan.The friend confirms, but at the same time puts Elena first.

programs.title: Happy Feet
programs.desc: Antarctica.Mambo was born in a land famous for penguins with vocal talent.Singing gives them a sense of community and cements relationships.Unfortunately, Mambo does not have this ability.His mother Norma Jean sees nothing wrong with it, but Memphis' father fears for the future of his son who, due to his inability, may never find his soul mate.The penguin has another valuable gift - he can tap dance perfectly.However, this is not enough for his friend Gloria, the best singer in the area and the leader of the Penguin Empire, who banishes Mamba.He thinks that he doesn't fit in with the rest of the herd.While traveling alone, the exile encounters alien penguins.They are delighted with his tap dancing ability and invite him to their land.There, the penguin discovers a very important truth in life, which says that being yourself is the most important thing.An excellent family film, awarded with an Oscar and a Golden Globe.

programs.title: Happy Feet Two
programs.desc: Mambo is the most popular tap dancing penguin in Antarctica and he is madly in love with the beautiful Gloria.The fruit of their love is the smart and resolute Eric.The boy, like his father once, tries to find his place in the world.However, it turns out that he does not share his parent's passion - he cannot and does not want to dance.Soon the little rebel meets the charismatic Sven, who can fly.Obsessed with his new idol, he distances himself more and more from his father.Meanwhile, the entire penguin population begins to face great danger.Mambo, with the help of his faithful friends Ramon and Lovelas, decides to fight to restore the old order in a frosty land... A continuation of the Oscar-winning animation about the adventures of an extraordinary penguin.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Bartosz Obuchowicz, Sonia Bohosiewicz, Cezary Pazura, Tomasz Kot and Wojciech Mecwaldowski.

programs.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
programs.desc: The Fellowship of the Ring has been broken.Frodo and Sam continue their journey to Mordor - the only place where the Ring can be destroyed.They manage to capture Gollum, one of the previous owners of the magical gem.Frodo decides to trust him.She makes him her guide.Meanwhile, Gandalf the Gray fights the Balrog, the Demon of Power.After the duel, the wizard is reborn as Gandalf the White.He joins Aragorn, Legolas the elf and Gimli the dwarf as they journey to Rohan.They must warn the local ruler Théoden about the war.It turns out that he can no longer rule.His faith and strength were robbed by a curse cast by Saruman.Merry and Pippin escape from orc captivity to Fangorn - an ancient forest.Treebeard, the shepherd of trees, takes care of them there.Middle-earth is threatened by great danger - Sauron, ruler of Mordor, and the wizard Saruman, lord of Isengard, unite their forces.Troops of wild Uruk-hai are growing in strength.The day of the Battle of Helm's Deep is approaching.
